processSection.title: How is Salt Made at PRODUSAL?
processSection.description: A harmonious blend of sun, wind, and sea: we sustainably transform Gulf seawater into world-class sea salt through solar evaporation and precision industrial washing.
processSection.completedDesc: High-purity sea salt ready for industrial dispatch and distribution.

steps.name: Seawater
steps.description: Controlled intake of pristine seawater from the Gulf of Venezuela into the complex's primary concentration lagoons.

steps.name: Concentration
steps.description: Intense solar radiation and steady trade winds evaporate water across 3,200 operating hectares, steadily raising brine concentration.

steps.name: Crystallization
steps.description: Saturated brine flows into crystallizer beds where high-purity sodium chloride crystals precipitate to meet strict industrial and food standards.

steps.name: Washing
steps.description: Harvested salt feeds two continuous industrial wash lines with saturated brine to wash away surface impurities while maintaining minimal moisture.

steps.name: Stockpiling
steps.description: Massive stockpiling in the storage yard for natural gravity drainage, crystal curing, and open-air drying.

steps.name: Dispatch
steps.description: Direct bulk loading into hopper trucks for petrochemical chlor-alkali plants, or milling and packing in 20 Kg bags and 1 MT Big Bags.

privacy.subtitle: Transparent, confidential, and secure management of commercial data for our clients, suppliers, and industrial partners.

responsible.title: 1. Data Controller Identification
responsible.address: Los Olivitos Saltworks Industrial Complex, Miranda Municipality, Eastern Shore of Lake Maracaibo, Zulia State, Venezuela.

sections.title: 2. Personal & Commercial Data We Collect
sections.content: Through our web forms and official quote channels, PRODUSAL C.A. only requests and stores data strictly necessary for B2B commercial interactions: full name, corporate email, company name, phone number, and salt requirement specifications (estimated tonnage, salt grade, delivery destination).

sections.title: 3. Purpose of Data Processing
sections.content: The provided data is used exclusively to: process quotations and purchase orders, provide official technical datasheets and laboratory certificates of analysis, coordinate industrial dispatch logistics (bulk hopper, Big Bags, 20 kg bags), and respond to technical or commercial inquiries.

sections.title: 4. Confidentiality & Non-Disclosure to Third Parties
sections.content: PRODUSAL C.A. does not sell, rent, lease, or transfer customer or prospective client data to third parties under any circumstances. All commercial information is held under strict industrial confidentiality in compliance with Venezuelan legal framework and international best practices.

sections.title: 5. Data Security & Storage
sections.content: We implement technical and organizational security measures (TLS/HTTPS in-transit encryption, access controls restricted to authorized commercial personnel) to protect data against unauthorized access, loss, or alteration.

sections.title: 6. Data Subject Rights (Access, Correction & Deletion)
sections.content: At any time, users or corporate representatives may exercise their rights to access, rectify, update, or delete their data by sending an email to info@grupomimesa.com with the subject line 'Data Protection'.

sections.title: 7. Use of Cookies & Web Technologies
sections.content: This website uses only essential technical cookies to ensure smooth browsing, remember language preferences (Spanish/English), and optimize loading performance without invasive tracking or third-party behavioral advertising.
